newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Yu Sung defaults on notes.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Yu Sung defaults on notes.

text.p: South Korea's Yu Sung Co Ltd, a textile manufacturer, said it has defaulted on payments of 227 million won worth of promissory notes on Tuesday.
A company statement said it planned to seek court protection by Wednesday.
The Korea Stock Exchange said on Tuesday that the trading in the stock would be halted from Wednesday morning.
Yu Sung posted a net profit of 437 million won last year on a turnover of 57.58 billion. Its paid-in capital stands at 15 billion won.
Yu Sung's default news follows a series of corporate insolvencies this year, started off by the collapse of Hanbo Steel in January and Sammi Steel in March.
Yu Sung closed up 100 won at 11,600 on Tuesday.
